name: Adam

team.summary: Founder Zach from YC W25 batch building Adam (CADAM), supported by an open source community.

product.summary: CADAM is an open source Text-to-CAD platform built as a React app running fully in-browser using WebAssembly and Three.js, generating parametric 3D models via OpenSCAD.

market.summary: Engineers and makers using mechanical CAD software who want to accelerate 3D modeling workflows using natural language prompts.

risks.risk: Current LLMs struggle heavily with spatial reasoning and real-world mechanical engineering constraints, making outputs prone to error for complex parts.
Reliance on OpenSCAD is criticized by professional engineers who prefer constraint-driven modeling or more powerful programmatic alternatives like CadQuery.

founder_depth.why: Founder is technical and shipping open-source infrastructure (YC W25), but deep domain specifics on prior mechanical engineering background are not detailed beyond building the tool.

shipping_evidence.why: Fully open-source GitHub repo with 51.3k+ stars (note: 5134 in text), live demo, in-browser WASM implementation, and active commits up to September 2026.

demand_signal.why: Strong HN engagement (215 points, 97 comments), active users reporting successful prints and prompt tests, alongside healthy GitHub traction.

defensibility.why: Open source codebase using standard models (Vercel AI SDK, OpenSCAD, WebAssembly) with commenters noting alternative text-to-CAD and open source options exist.

analysis.thesis_fit_reason: CADAM is a developer and engineering tool (AI-native mechanical CAD generation) built by a technical founder shipping in public.
analysis.case_summary: Strong public engineering execution and viral developer interest, offset by inherent LLM spatial limitations and reliance on OpenSCAD.
would_change_my_mind: Integration with constraint-driven modeling tools like build123d and CadQuery.
Demonstrated adoption by professional mechanical engineering teams for manufacturing-ready parts.
Data showing how spatial reasoning deficiencies are solved systematically.
data_gaps: Exact revenue or commercial metrics for the adam.new commercial product.
Background details on the founding team other than Zach.
